It completely omitted the opt-in configuration flag `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it violated an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store does not implement `listFor`, whereas the ticket explicitly mandates returning an `error` frame (`UNSUPPORTED`) and never an empty list. It also missed the `limit` bounds validation (1-200, accepting 0 and >200 instead), `StoreCannotList`, and the `example/full-config.ts` / `docs/getting-started.md` updates. On the positive side, it did handle the request off the per-session lock, used the composite `before` cursor, and took `userId` from the authenticated session rather than the frame.
